answer: A whole reef cannot be watched by one guard, but chance can watch it. Each epoch the ledger quietly draws twenty random accounts and demands a fresh handwritten signature — quill dipped, ink still wet — inside one hour. A human signs without thinking; a thousand cloned sybils each need a scheduled gesture, and that sums into days of attention no payout repays. Miss two audits and the seat dissolves; by zenith, the ghosts have gone home.
